I am an old woman of 65, farming this small maize plot near my compound. My husband passed and my sons help small-small, but money is tight — I will buy a little NPK if the agro-dealer brings the subsidized one, and add the goat and chicken droppings I gather from the compound. I plant the same maize seed I saved from last year together with cowpea between the stands, the way we always do here in the North. I cannot afford to hire many people, so my daughters-in-law and grandchildren will help me with weeding.
